WITH lab_with_patient AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    l.PT,
    l.IGA,
    l.IGM,
    p.SEX,
    CASE WHEN l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL THEN l.IGA - l.IGM ELSE NULL END AS iga_igm_diff
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
patient_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(PT) AS avg_pt,
    AVG(iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff
  FROM lab_with_patient
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(iga_igm_diff) AS overall_mean_iga_igm
  FROM lab_with_patient
),
patient_with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.ID,
    pa.SEX,
    pa.avg_pt,
    pa.avg_iga_igm_diff,
    CASE 
      WHEN pa.avg_iga_igm_diff IS NOT NULL AND om.overall_mean_iga_igm IS NOT NULL AND om.overall_mean_iga_igm != 0 
      THEN pa.avg_iga_igm_diff / om.overall_mean_iga_igm 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio_to_overall_mean
  FROM patient_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
)
SELECT 
  SEX,
  AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt,
  AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS average_iga_igm_difference,
  AVG(ratio_to_overall_mean) AS average_ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM patient_with_ratio
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;
